_about: THE LAB'S BOOK (BESTIARY 11/9, VAMILY rule 440(f); laws/BOHEMIA_LAW_THE_BEASTS_ARE_LAB_MADE_AND_THE_BESTIARY_FLOOR_9_29_26.md). Every LAB-MADE beast the fight fields: the animal (its fight sheet, slices/fight_rig/beast_<animal>), the beast party it comes in (records/target/bb/bohemia_enemies.json factions), the rows that are this animal, the species, the fossil it was grown from (site, state, the paper), whether its DNA has been read (law s2: Ice Age and after is readable; 'read' when a paper read it), the living mother of the right size that carried it, and why it lives in the Mojave (his 9/30 test). The floor (law s4: 17 beasts, at least) counts THIS list, and only animals the fight really fields (gates/the_bestiary_floor_gate.py). A modder adds a beast here, its party and row in bohemia_enemies.json and its sheet in slices/fight_rig/fight_rig.json. Never radiation, never a dinosaur (law s1, s2).
